question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Confuse
solution:
The correct answer is **"Puzzle."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Confuse** means to cause someone to become bewildered or perplexed. (उलझन में डाल देना; गड़बड़ा या चकरा देना; सोच-विचार में दुविधा पैदा करना)

 
 
• **Example**:* He **confused__** everybody with his pages of facts and figures.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of **confuse include puzzle, baffle, mystify, and bewilder**.
 
• **Puzzle** means to make somebody feel confused because he/she does not understand something. (किसी को उलझन में डाल देना (बात को समझ न पाने के कारण))
 __
 
• **Example**: *The instructions for assembling the furniture puzzled me, and I had to ask for help.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1: Admit** means to allow entry or access, or to acknowledge the truth of something. (किसी अप्रिय बात की सत्‍यता स्‍वीकारना या अपनी ग़लती मान लेना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The hospital will only **admit**__ patients who have a referral from their doctor.*
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Compose** means to create or write something, or to make up the parts of something. (घटकों का अपने से बड़ी वस्‍तु को बनाना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She **composed**__ a beautiful poem for her friend's wedding.*
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Disunion** means a state of separation or division. (अलगाव या विभाजन की अवस्था)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The **disunion**__ of the company's partners caused a lot of tension in the workplace.*
